description: Compute statistics on one list of the user's own Parfumo collection: most frequent brands, dominant notes and accords, perfumers, genders, concentrations, decades, seasons and occasions, money spent per currency, wear counts, most worn perfumes and perfumes never worn. Computed by this server from the list; use it for overviews and recommendations. Requires a linked Parfumo account.
name: parfumo_collection_stats

CollectionList.description: One list of the member's collection (ShelfControl `data-lists`).

count.description: Number of perfumes in the list.

custom.description: True for a list created by the member.

hidden.description: True when the list is hidden from other members.

id.description:
Numeric list id: 1 have, 2 had, 3 want (Wish List), 4 memo (Watch List), 5 tested,
6 filling (Decants), 7 mini (Miniatures); custom lists have a larger id.

slug.description:
Slug usable as `collection` argument: `have`, `had`, `want`, `memo`, `tested`,
`filling`, `mini`, or the numeric id of a custom list.

url.description: ShelfControl URL of the list (account page).

currency.description: Currency code, or `unknown` when a price has no currency.

priced_items.description: Number of entries with a price in this currency.

total_paid.description: Sum of the prices paid (price × nothing: the site stores one price per entry).

perfume_id.description: Perfume identifier usable with every perfume tool.

community_average_rating.description: Average community scent rating of the list (0-10).

never_worn.description: Perfumes never worn (first ones, in list order).

never_worn_count.description: Number of perfumes of the list never logged as worn.

notes.description: Dominant fragrance notes across the list.

rated_items.description: Number of perfumes the member rated for scent, and the average of those ratings (0-10).

remaining_ml_total.description: Millilitres left, summed over the entries where it is recorded.

seasons.description: Seasons the community associates with the perfumes.

total_items.description: Number of entries (perfumes) in the list.

total_wears.description: Logged wears, summed over the list.

value.description: Money spent, per currency (amounts in different currencies are never added up).
